title: RollPay
tagline: Private payroll platform powered by INTMAX privacy & Zircuit EIP-7702 integration
description:
RollPay is a pricate payroll platform that lets companies pay employees privately and paying gas fees in USDC using EIP-7702 standart

Traditional payroll is expensive, slow, and lacks privacy. Companies pay high fees to banks, employees wait days for payments, and all transaction data is visible to intermediaries.

RollPay enables companies to manage payroll entirely on blockchain with zero transaction costs and complete privacy. Companies can add employees, set salaries, and send bulk payments instantly.

Onboard non-tech users: No need to pay costs with ether for payroll, use USDC!

Complete Privacy: Salary amounts are hidden from everyone except sender and receiver
Employees get paid immediately
Pay hundreds of employees in one transaction
Easy employee and payment management
how_its_made:
We combine two technologies:
INTMAX Stateless Rollup: Provides privacy through zero-knowledge proofs
Zircuit EIP-7702 Smart Accounts: Enables gas sponsored transactions and bulk payments
Companies upload their payroll list, and RollPay handles the rest - splitting payments, ensuring privacy, and delivering funds instantly.
Who It's For?
Companies of any size wanting to modernize payroll, especially remote-first organizations and privacy-conscious businesses.
Let us introduce the future of payrolls: Private, Instant, and Free from traditional banking limitations!
